items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Well, there was a couple of fellows around these other nightclubs too, like Jimmy Noon, Freddie, what was his name? Keppard maybe.

ctx.x: Yes. That's why at the Lincoln Garden, I mean the Royal Garden, they would be so crowded, the musicians around looking and listening and learning.

Joe Oliver and them started it. Well, there was a couple of fellows around these other nightclubs too, like Jimmy Noon, Freddie, what was his name? Keppard maybe. Keppard. Freddie Keppard, yes. Did you ever work with him?
